inputs.prompt: <Video 1> <Picture 1> <Picture 2> A warm emotional scene in front of an old 1990s Chinese factory dormitory stairwell entrance, soft golden morning light. The action is one continuous unhurried motion, beginning to end: an elderly Chinese grandmother with a neat silver hair bun, wearing a clean indigo-blue apron over a gray jacket, stands facing a small Chinese girl around five years old with a black bob haircut and neat bangs, wearing a clean pale-yellow cotton jacket. At the start, the grandmother holds a long bright red silk hair ribbon in her raised right hand beside the girl's head. Slowly and gently, she lifts the red ribbon up over the top of the girl's head, brings the two ends down, and ties them into a small neat bow on top of the girl's hair; her hands move only around the girl's head in a smooth steady motion. At the end, the red ribbon bow sits on top of the girl's head, and the grandmother's hands lower down to rest. The little girl stands still the whole time, head tilted slightly up, eyes looking at the grandmother, hands hanging quietly at her sides. Both characters remain standing in the same spot from beginning to end — no walking, no sitting down, no standing up, no posture change; only the grandmother's hands move, doing the hair-tying. Both characters have clear detailed faces exactly matching the reference portraits <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>. The concrete stairwell and green metal handrail of the old dormitory are in the soft-focus background. Refined watercolor concept-art animation style, delicate fine ink linework, loose transparent watercolor washes, granular cold-press paper texture, restrained indigo black denim-grey and cream palette with the single vivid red accent of the ribbon, warm luminous morning light, tender nostalgic atmosphere, slow continuous camera push-in, gentle seamless motion, no cuts.
